#  13185 - Status Seminar Cognitive and Dependable Systems Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13185 - module is no longer offered from SS 2024**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Status Seminar Cognitive and Dependable Systems**  |  
|  Statusseminar Cognitive and Dependable Systems   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. habil. Cunningham, Douglas 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 6 semesters  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | The students are enabled to scientifically present their own work. They know the goals, tasks, methods, work plan and results of their own dissertation as well as those of their fellow students. They are able to classify the status of their own and other scientific work. They can discuss critically with their fellow students in the presence of their supervisors.  |  
| Contents:  | The content are defined PhD Theses of the current students. The sequence of presentations is organized by the PhD program committee in cooperation with students and supervisors.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 6 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Will be presented in the first course of each semester.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * First presentation 15 min. and discussion of the results (20%)
  * Second presentation 15 min. and discussion of the results (40%)
  * Third presentation 15 min. and discussion of the results (40%)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Every Term: Status Seminar „Cognitive and Dependable Systems“ with one hour per week

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 02.11.2023 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
